description: One-step Zero-Slippage Atomic Swap builder on Base Mainnet (Chain ID: 8453) via Uniswap v4 RFQ Hook (0xd72CD1d46bA05479583fbB561B558f133BA98088). Quotes flat Chainlink Oracle price (-0.30% fee, 0% AMM curve price impact) backed by $3.25B+ Morpho Blue & KyberSwap liquidity, and returns the exact PoolKey, SwapParams, and ECDSA-signed bytes hookData for PoolManager.swap.

amountIn.description: Input amount (human-readable by default, or wei if isWei=true)

isWei.description: Set true if amountIn is already in raw wei/smallest unit

tokenIn.description: Input token symbol or address on Base (USDC, WETH, cbBTC, cbETH, wstETH, AERO, EURC)

tokenOut.description: Output token symbol or address on Base (USDC, WETH, cbBTC, cbETH, wstETH, AERO, EURC)
